correctness.rationale: The exact face predicate exhaustively checks all 4096 vertex subsets and finds 45 independent four-sets, 2533 augmented faces. A fixed staged matching yields 1245 matched pairs; the 12780-incidence directed Hasse graph topologically sorts all 2533 faces, and its ordinary restriction sorts all 2532 nonempty faces, proving no closed gradient paths. One vertex and 43 four-cells remain, giving an integral homotopy wedge of 43 four-spheres via discrete Morse. Separate direct boundary computations over three finite fields corroborate but do not replace the proof. Exhaustive graph automorphisms (48) and signed invariant-face Lefschetz sums establish the ten conjugacy-class traces, satisfying class-weighted trace zero.

value.rationale: The Franklin graph is a canonical highly symmetric cubic bipartite twelve-vertex graph with four-cycles, outside the complete bipartite and high-girth formula domains for which total four-cut values are known. The exact four-parameter topological answer identifies 43 integral four-spheres in a pure seven-complex, yielding a concrete non-shellability obstruction. The full rational character on all ten automorphism conjugacy classes and vanishing invariant subspace reveal symmetry undetectable by Betti counts. This motivated finite benchmark is significant without asserting an unproved infinite classification.
